text:
maria_cs: Heads up — onboarding jobs for ~25 trial tenants in EU failed between 03:10–03:18 UTC. Creating a customer-facing update; @devon_se can you confirm root cause?

ops_bot: incident created INC-2026-314 · severity: HIGH · details: https://status.redwood.example/inc/INC-2026-314

devon_se: Investigating. Early signal: webhook retries timed out because token refreshes overlapped and some cached creds became stale. See errors: `401 -> 502` during refresh window.

leo_eng: Confirmed from infra side. Token refresh job overlapped with bulk onboard job and the refresh endpoint hit our rate limiter. Plan: add mutex around tenant refresh + backoff tweaks. I'll push a patch in ~45m.

maria_cs: Thanks. Drafting the customer note (short). Sharing here so we can tailor for the five high-touch accounts before sending.

maria_cs: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE:
```
Hi <Customer>,

We detected intermittent onboarding failures affecting new tenant webhooks between 03:10–03:18 UTC. Root cause: concurrent token refreshes caused auth failures for a subset of tenants. Mitigation: we retried failed jobs and deployed a patch to prevent overlapping refreshes at 04:05 UTC.

Next steps: we are re-running any remaining failed onboarding jobs and will provide a post-incident summary with remediation steps. As a goodwill gesture we are applying a one-week premium credit to affected trial tenants; enterprise customers will receive tailored SLA credit offers.

If you'd like a walk-through or an office hours slot, sign up here: https://cal.redwood.example/impact-office-hours

Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
```

aj_sales: For enterprise customers recommend 10% invoice credit + a dedicated enablement session. For small trials, 1-week premium credit + invite to office hours works.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll schedule 1:1 outreach for the top 5 and send a bulk note to the rest. Office hours invite scheduled for tomorrow 15:00 UTC — signup: https://cal.redwood.example/impact-office-hours

devon_se: Patch deployed to prod (v1.14.3). Added token-refresh mutex and `auth.refresh.lock_wait` metric. Re-running failed onboarding queue now.

ops_bot: CI: build passed · deployment v1.14.3 · https://ci.redwood.example/build/1245

leo_eng: Re-runs progressing — 20/25 tenants completed successfully so far. 5 remain in retry queue, ETA ~20m.

maria_cs: Draft email has legal sign-off. I'll send the tailored messages at 05:10 UTC and begin high-touch outreach. Please drop any account-specific asks here.

aj_sales: For ACME Corp please include explicit SLA credit language and cc @cto_jake. I'll own the outreach for them.

maria_cs: Noted. Also proposing we offer a guided migration call and provide the postmortem recording when ready.

devon_se: Short RCA summary for CS: token rotation lacked a global lock which allowed concurrent refresh storms; the refresh endpoint throttled under concurrency returning 429s that cascaded as 502s to onboarding service. Full RCA to follow with timeline and remediations.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Perfect — I'll add that to the technical appendix. Closing loop: when the last tenant finishes I'll post a final status update and proceed with customer emails.
